policy: Map production identity, legal, asset, homepage, website, portal, gift and module-switch inputs. Optional values may be omitted; disabled features require an explicit notApplicable record where the schema defines one.

explicitDisableOrNotApplicable.brand.personalRegisterGiftContractCount: 0 explicitly disables the personal registration gift
explicitDisableOrNotApplicable.brand.enterpriseRegisterGiftContractCoun: 0 explicitly disables the enterprise registration gift

intentionallyExcludedBrandColumns.qq: Legacy optional contact channel; not a production baseline requirement.
intentionallyExcludedBrandColumns.website_source_url: Source repository links are not public customer deployment identity.
intentionallyExcludedBrandColumns.website_stat_company_count: Marketing statistics require runtime evidence and must not be fabricated by a profile.
intentionallyExcludedBrandColumns.website_stat_sign_count: Marketing statistics require runtime evidence and must not be fabricated by a profile.
intentionallyExcludedBrandColumns.website_lowest_unit_price: Commercial pricing is not a public deployment-profile default.
